welcome.move.title: Move OrbitDrop to the Applications folder?
welcome.move.body: OrbitDrop is running outside the Applications folder (from a disk image, Downloads…). In Applications, opening at login works reliably and the disk image can be ejected. OrbitDrop restarts after the move.
welcome.move.replaceTitle: OrbitDrop is already in the Applications folder
welcome.move.replaceBody: Move the existing OrbitDrop to the Trash and replace it with this version?
crash.helper.title: Global drag stopped
crash.helper.body: The drag helper stopped after crashing several times. Click this notification to restart it. Meanwhile, Open File and the Drop Zone still work.
crash.window.closedBody: The window kept crashing, so it was closed. Your original files weren't changed. If it happens again, please use Help › Report a Problem.
crash.window.closedBodyUnsaved: The window kept crashing, so it was closed. Unsaved annotations or redaction areas were lost. Your original files weren't changed.
crash.main.title: OrbitDrop ran into an unexpected error
crash.main.body: You can keep using it, but if something behaves oddly, restart OrbitDrop. Details are in main.log in the log folder (paths are hidden).
crash.startup.title: OrbitDrop couldn't start
crash.startup.body: An error occurred while starting. Details are in main.log in the log folder. If it happens again, please report it as described on the OrbitDrop website.
